bifrost: bifrost_app::audio (springboard/src/svc.rs), springboard/audiod, springboard/src/media/capture.rs, v4l2.rs, springboard/src/shell/camera/, springboard/ui/src/speech.rs, springboard/core/src/meter.rs
summary: Audio playback and microphone recording work through an audio service with an SDK client, and the shell has a V4L2 camera pipeline for the Camera app. Speech utterances, voice selection and a speech queue exist as pure models; there is no speech engine yet. Level metering exists as a pure model that the recorder does not call yet. Apps get no camera capture API, no capture session model, no photo or depth capture, no audio engine graph and no audible speech.

features.note: V4L2 probing exists in the shell only; no session/input/output model and no SDK access for apps
Camera app takes JPEGs with EXIF, self-timer, square crop; no app-facing photo output, no Live Photos, RAW or settings objects

features.feature: Audio and video capture (movie files, sample buffers)
features.note: Microphone to WAV works via audiod; no video recording to file, no sample buffer outputs for apps, no preview layer API
Only an in-app QR scanner; no depth, face or barcode metadata outputs, no synchronizer
Sandbox doc lists a portal for devices as future work; no per-app camera or microphone prompt
Queue, repeat, live streams, transport over a socket, client at bifrost_app::audio; used by Music and Podcasts. No AVAudioPlayer-style per-object players or pan/rate per player

Record start/stop to WAV through the audio service. Peak and average level per channel are computed by the pure meter model (dBFS, floor -160), not yet wired to the recorder; no format settings, no AAC/ALAC recording

features.apple: AVAudioEngine, AVAudioNode, AVAudioUnit effects, AVAudioFile, AVAudioPCMBuffer
features.note: File decode and conversion helpers exist; no node graph, effects, mixer nodes or buffer API for apps
Speaker/headphone route, volume memory and ALSA mixer in the shell; no app-facing session categories or route change notifications

Utterance settings with clamped rate, pitch, volume and post-delay; voice choice by language tag; a speak/pause/resume/stop queue. Pure model only: no engine produces audio and no SDK API or app uses it yet
Recorder picks the first working PCM/format; no settings dictionary

gaps: App-facing capture API (session, device discovery, inputs and outputs) for camera and microphone
Per-app camera and microphone permission prompts
Speech engine that produces audio, and an SDK API for apps to speak utterances
Audio engine graph with effects and buffers
Video recording to file and sample buffer outputs
Depth, metadata and synchronized multi-output capture
Recording settings and compressed formats; wiring the level meter into the recorder
